name: r3_ramsey_three_three_pigeonhole
statement: (V : Type) [Fintype V] (h : 6 ≤ Fintype.card V) (G : SimpleGraph V) : ∃ v x y z : V, x ≠ y ∧ x ≠ z ∧ y ≠ z ∧ ((G.Adj v x ∧ G.Adj v y ∧ G.Adj v z) ∨ (Gᶜ.Adj v x ∧ Gᶜ.Adj v y ∧ Gᶜ.Adj v z))
closed: ∀ (V : Type) [Fintype V] (h : 6 ≤ Fintype.card V) (G : SimpleGraph V), ∃ v x y z : V, x ≠ y ∧ x ≠ z ∧ y ≠ z ∧ ((G.Adj v x ∧ G.Adj v y ∧ G.Adj v z) ∨ (Gᶜ.Adj v x ∧ Gᶜ.Adj v y ∧ Gᶜ.Adj v z))
informal: Pigeonhole step of R(3,3)<=6 (hole 2 of the r3_ramsey_three_three skeleton; proposed by hand because sketch left an orphan child that blocks re-sketching): in a graph on >= 6 vertices some vertex v has three distinct neighbours or three distinct non-neighbours.
type: ∀ (V : Type) [inst : Fintype V], 6 ≤ Fintype.card V → ∀ (G : SimpleGraph V), ∃ v x y z, x ≠ y ∧ x ≠ z ∧ y ≠ z ∧ (G.Adj v x ∧ G.Adj v y ∧ G.Adj v z ∨ Gᶜ.Adj v x ∧ Gᶜ.Adj v y ∧ Gᶜ.Adj v z)
